dct_title_s: Sao Tome and Principe - Subnational Administrative Boundaries
dct_description_sm: Sao Tome and Principe administrative level 0-1 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 1 level: - Admin 1: 7 Province Note: São Tomé and Príncipe comprises two provinces (São Tomé and Príncipe) at Admin 1, subdivided into 7 districts at Admin 2. Six districts are located on São Tomé island (Água Grande, Cantagalo, Caué, Lembá, Lobata, Mé-Zóchi) and one (Pagué) covers Príncipe island. The island of Príncipe has held autonomous region status since 1995. Dates associated with this dataset: - 01 June 2026: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 01 June 2026: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 01 June 2026: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 17 August 2020: boundaries created by the source Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
